PRIVACY

Privacy
Policy.

Last updated: September 16, 2026

Thanks for visiting the official website of Yu Stellar (yustellar.idv.tw, referred to below as "this site"). This page explains what information is collected while you browse, how cookies are used, and which third-party services this site relies on.

1. Information this site collects

This site does not ask you to create an account or submit personal data on your own. If you contact us through the email button on the site, or correspond with us by email, we only use the information you provide (such as your email address and message content) to reply to you — it is never used for any other purpose or shared with third parties.

2. Cookies and similar technologies

This site uses a small number of cookies / local storage to remember your browsing preferences, such as whether you've already seen and responded to the cookie notice. You can clear or block cookies at any time through your browser settings, though this may affect some features.

If this site enables Google AdSense or other advertising services in the future, those services may use cookies or device identifiers to show personalized ads based on your past browsing behavior on this site and others. You can manage your personalized-ad preferences at Google Ads Settings, or use your browser's "Do Not Track" and third-party cookie-blocking features.

3. Third-party services used on this site

  • YouTube (Google LLC): The "Videos" section on this site embeds YouTube videos and shows thumbnails of the latest uploads. Clicking play loads the embedded player from youtube-nocookie.com; see Google's Privacy Policy for details.
  • Google Fonts: This site's typefaces (Noto Sans TC, Space Grotesk) are loaded via Google Fonts, which means your browser connects to Google's servers while loading them.
  • Google AdSense (if enabled): If advertising is enabled, Google and its advertising partners may use cookies to serve ads and measure their performance; see Google's ad technology explanation for details.
  • GitHub Pages: This site is hosted on GitHub Pages. Server logs may include general connection records such as visitors' IP addresses, used solely for operations and security purposes.

4. Data retention and your rights

This site does not sell your personal data. If you'd like to know, correct, or delete any information we hold related to your contact with us, feel free to reach out through the contact email on the site.

5. Policy updates

This page may be updated from time to time as regulations or the site's features change; you're welcome to check back periodically. If there's a significant change, we'll update the "Last updated" date at the top of the page.

6. Contact us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, feel free to email us at hello@yustellar.idv.tw.
